name: News, Newspapers
description: Today's newspaper front pages from the Freedom Forum archive, one paper per render. Rotates through the papers on its admin page, each with its own optional CSS, or shows one pinned paper. Keeps the last good page up while a paper isn't out yet. No API key.

cell_options.name: paper
cell_options.label: Paper
cell_options.help: One paper every time, or the next paper from the list on the widget's admin page on each render.
